---
title: Vendor Notes & Activities
description: Keep internal notes and schedule activities for each vendor.
---

The **Vendors Management** menu includes dedicated **Notes** and **Activites**
pages, so you can keep a record of internal notes and communication for each
vendor.

Both pages work the same way: select a **Vendor** at the top of the page to see
that vendor's records, and use **Search** to search them. The selected vendor appears as a filter chip — select
**Clear** to remove it.

## Notes

Go to **Vendors Management → Notes**.

The list shows each note's **Title**, **Created By**, **Created At**, and
**Actions**.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-notes-list.jpg" alt="Vendor Notes page" caption="(1) New Note, (2) Vendor, (3) Search." />

### Create a note

<Steps>

<Step>
### Select the vendor
Choose the vendor in the **Vendor** field.
</Step>

<Step>
### Open the note form
Select **New Note**. The **Create New Note** dialog opens.
</Step>

<Step>
### Enter the note
Enter a **Title** and a **Description**. Both are required.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-new-note.jpg" alt="Create New Note dialog" caption="(1) Title, (2) Description, (3) Create." width={760} />
</Step>

<Step>
### Save
Select **Create** to save the note, or **Cancel** to close the dialog.
</Step>

</Steps>

## Activities

Go to **Vendors Management → Activites**.

The list shows each activity's **Type**, **Regarding**, **Scheduled For**,
**Scheduled With**, **Start Time**, **End Time**, **Status**, **Priority**, and
**Actions**. From **Actions** you can view, edit, or delete an activity.

<Screenshot src="/images/purchases/vendors/vendor-activities-list.jpg" alt="Vendor Activities page" caption="(1) New Activity, (2) Vendor, (3) Search." />

### Create an activity

<Steps>

<Step>
### Select the vendor
Choose the vendor in the **Vendor** field, then select **New Activity**.
</Step>

<Step>
### Enter the activity details

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| Type | For example, **Meeting**. |
| Status | For example, **Todo**. |
| Description | Required. |
| Priority | For example, **Medium**. |
| Regarding | For example, **Finance** or **Accounting**. |
| Start Time / End Time | When the activity takes place. |
| Scheduled For | Required. |
| Scheduled With | Required. |
| Meeting Link | Optional link for online meetings. |
</Step>

<Step>
### Save
Select **Create** to save the activity, or **Cancel** to discard it.
</Step>

</Steps>
